concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-drop-in-setup-and-integration-ios-v7]] - captured iOS v7-routed Drop-in setup snapshot whose body says v7 is not supported through Drop-in, routes Drop-in users to v5, and carries dated 2026/2027 lifecycle and migration notices; not current support or payment-processing evidence
warnings: The route path includes iOS v7, but the retained body explicitly says v7 is not supported through Drop-in; do not treat the URL as v7 Drop-in compatibility evidence.
BraintreeDropIn is independently versioned from the modular Braintree iOS SDK, and this snapshot does not prove current support or successful payment processing.
